finalText:
Done. `CHANGELOG.md` now has the 4.2.0 entry.

Out of 380 commits and 128 "merged PRs," almost all of it really is noise — the same handful of refactor/dep-bump patterns (`collapse the two retry helpers`, `drop the unused v2 debug helper`, `rename Ctx to RequestCtx`, dependency bumps) applied identically across every module (http, db, api, jobs, queue, billing, webhooks, auth, core, store). I filtered those out along with tests, CI, and internal docs, and kept only what changes observable behavior:

- **Breaking**: expired tokens now return 401, not 403 — worth flagging since anyone branching on status code will need to update.
- **Added**: webhook delivery retries with exponential backoff (the one genuine `feat`).
- **Fixed**: 10 items, mostly the same bug class (null-cursor pagination, duplicate retry headers, double-trimmed trailing slash, empty-allowlist handling, token-parser messages) recurring across multiple modules — I collapsed each into one bullet naming the affected areas rather than listing every module's commit separately. Also flagged the request-body-logging fix since it's privacy-relevant.

One judgment call worth double-checking with you: I put the 401/403 change under **Breaking** rather than **Fixed** since it changes an existing wire contract — let me know if you'd rather it sit under Fixed instead.
